title: CoverStory bounded synchronous renewal-preview reads: Days 71–84
status_semantics: Contracts and seams are plans. Scaffold, learner implementation, runtime verification and integration status are independent. Dates never imply learner completion.
scope: Add one process-local nonblocking capacity gate of 2 around the existing synchronous owner-scoped renewal-preview read. Reuse Hikari maximum pool 4; set finite acquisition timeout; sanitize capacity errors; add bounded metrics, accessible manual UI recovery, then real pool and packaged browser recovery. No async work, queue, retries, new business route, schema change, fault route, or infrastructure for its own sake. Reuse the completed Day48 owner-scoped SQL without duplicating its query.

capacity_decision.admission: immediate nonblocking rejection; no wait queue
capacity_decision.pool_availability_guarantee: none; a two-permit preview gate does not reserve Hikari connections or guarantee availability to other routes
capacity_decision.connection_timeout_policy_note: 250..30000ms is the project validation range, not a Hikari library maximum

dsa_revision_policy.retrieval_method: cold recall and re-solve; do not reread
dsa_revision_policy.failed_review_rule: Failed due reviews displace new work within the same 60-minute block.
